sections.text:
The MBCZ10 bus bar protection is 
 Modular, solid state, low impedance biased differential based on the 
 circulating current principle and dual cratered of operation, provides 
 continuous supervision of CT secondary circuits and constant monitoring of 
 vital circuits extremely stable up to the Max switch gear.

This procedure details the steps 
 required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
 MBCZ10 relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on a yearly 
 bases. This work be carried out section of this document is divided into 3 
 sections.

The first preliminary steps to 
 prepare for relay testing describes the activities required prior to testing. 
 Some of these steps could be performed days before the actual test. The second 
 section Preparation for testing describes the steps to set up the equipment 
 for performing the actual tests. The third section is the actual test.

The 
 document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
 personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Heba Abd Elmonem, revised by eng. Abd Elnasser Moustafa, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Shawky Attalla, approved by eng. Abdel 
 Elmegeed Emara: head sector of SIDI KRIR Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Mona 
 Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.

Testing the Relay 
and Protection O/P

items:
Carefully follow 
 this test procedure .

Verify the test 
 results match the relay setting, if not consult technical services.

Test trip all

sections.text:
Check of the MBCZ 
10 Operating Values Differential Supervision Relays

Injection Tests 
via the test unit

items:
Turn the key 
 switch on the alarm unit to the protection out position.

Remove the covers 
 from the test unit and the zone unit to be checked.

Plug test lead 
 into the test unit using the end of the lead with the 3-5 m jack plug, the 2 m 
 plug on the other end of the test lead is then plugged into the test I/P on 
 the phase of the zone to be tested (1).

Block the trip 
 O/P relay for a short period during the test.

Set the selection 
 switch on the front of the test unit to inject X I and set the digital Current 
 switch to 00.

Set the MAN/AUTO 
 switch to MAN.

Set the current 
 to 80% of the marked value of the selected setting and the relay should not 
 indicate a trip.

Increase the 
 current to the marked setting value and the protection should operate.

There should be a 
 trip indication on the element begin tested and 2 protection operated.

Indication on the 
 alarm unit, the latter has a /5 seconds delay.

Release the 
 injection bottom and rest the indication.

Check that when 
 the inject button is now depressed the trip is instantaneously, and that when 
 the current is injected for five seconds no pratic fail indication comes up.

Repeat steps from 
 1 to 6 on the other two phases and then on each other zone in turn.

Increase the 
 current until the meter reads current just below the setting of the 
 Supervision relay.

Then increase 
 slowly until the supervision operates to indicate a CT fault.

Repeat steps from 
 (1 to 2 ) on the other phases and then on each other zone in Turn.

Switch off each 
 of the protection power supplies in turn.

Check that alarm 
 in given each time, also the protection should continue to function on the 
 supply from the remaining power supply unites.

When the power 
 supply for the isolation relay is turned off check that all isolation

Supervision 
 alarms operate.

sections.text:
Test Supervision 
for Isolator Repeat Relays

items:
Switches off the 
 power supply to the isolator repeat relay circuit.

The indicators 
 for the isolator repeat relay supervision should light up, will be followed 
 after a delay by an alarm indication on the modules containing the repeat 
 relays.

The power fail 
 alarm should also be initiated by the action of switching off the power 
 Supply.

sections.text: Units for External Breaker Fail BZT Check

items:
To test BZT relay 
 first ensure that the key switch is a protection out, then bridge the BZT 
 Contacts.

Check that the 
 feeder under test and all the circuit breaker modules connected to the same 
 Main zone and the alarm unite show a trip indication.

If the feeder is 
 not connected to main zone (because all its isolators are open) check that 
 Protection operated appears on the alarm unit followed by common alarm.

Relay and Associated Equipment to Service

items:
Remove the plug 
 test lead from the test module also from the measuring zone to be tested.

If any equipment 
 with the relay has been isolate without the test plug, it should be returned 
 to service.

items:
Take crossed 
 reading of all AC currents supplied to the relay and compare them to those for 
 normal load condition.

Check that 
 reading agree with station meters (MW/MVAR/ power factor amperes/ Voltages).

Zone measuring modules

Close all the bus
